observations.body: Jesus names himself the true vine and the Father the farmer, calls disciples to abide and bear fruit, connects words and prayer, commands mutual love, calls them friends, and says he chose them.
observations.label: Vine, branches, abiding, fruit, friendship, and chosen love

observations.body: The passage presents Abiding, pruning, asking, loving, and choosing as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Abiding, pruning, asking, loving, and choosing

observations.body: The passage places Servants called friends beside Abiding, pruning, asking, loving, and choosing.
observations.label: Servants called friends

payload.posture: Read John 15:1–17 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus names himself the true vine and the Father the farmer, calls disciples to abide and bear fruit, connects words and prayer, commands mutual love, calls them friends, and says he chose them. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Last Supper.
payload.title: Vine, branches, abiding, fruit, friendship, and chosen love
